## Sources
- OCCT BRepOffset_MakeOffset.cxx:4518 (CannotExtentEdge) (uncovered class evidence)

## Description

An offset edge needs to be extended past its source endpoints to meet a neighbouring offset edge, but the underlying curve cannot be evaluated outside its domain (e.g., the curve is a B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS with clamped boundary knots — multiplicity equal to degree+1 at both ends — so the curve has no analytic extrapolation). Bug-reporter language: "can't extend offset edge", "offset edge runs out", "clamped B-spline cannot extend".

## Reproducer recipe

A B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS with clamped boundary (e.g., degree 2, 3 control points, knot multiplicities (3,3) at (0.0, 1.0)) used as an EDGE_CURVE; offset request requires extension past the trim domain.

## Expected kernel behavior

Extrapolate via tangent prolongation; or terminate the offset at the trim boundary.

## Notes

Synonyms: "offset extrapolation failure".
